title: Rank-one tester acceptance probability
statement: For $n\ge 0$, let $\ell:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ and $q:\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb F_2$. The rank-one tester's acceptance probability is the average, over independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $z\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$, of the indicator that $\ell(x)\ell(y)=q(Z)+q(Z+xy^{\mathsf T})$ in $\mathbb F_2$, where $Z$ is the matrix obtained by reshaping $z$.
